signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.helper: Enter your work email address. If you have an account, we will send you a sign-in code.

otp.title: Check your email
otp.instructions: We sent a verification code to {{email}}.
otp.expired: The code has expired. Request a new one.

totp.title: Two-factor authentication
totp.instructions: Enter the code from your authenticator app.

totpEnrol.title: Set up two-factor authentication
totpEnrol.scanQr: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app

stepUp.title: Verify your identity
stepUp.description: We sent a verification code to your email address. Enter it to continue.
stepUp.unavailable: This action cannot be verified for your account right now. Please try again later.

invite.title: You have been invited
invite.expired: This invitation has expired or is no longer valid.

reset.title: Reset your password
reset.success: Password reset successfully. You can now sign in.
reset.instructions: We sent a reset code to {{email}}.

context.expired: Your organisation session has expired. Switched to personal context.

error.invalidCode: The code you entered is not valid.
error.challengeExpired: That code has expired or was already used. Request a new one.
error.invalidCredentials: The email or password is not correct.
error.expired: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
error.locked: Too many attempts. Try again in {{minutes}} minutes.
error.network: Unable to reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
error.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
error.passwordTooShort: Password must be at least 8 characters.

lockout.title: Account temporarily locked
lockout.body: Too many unsuccessful attempts. Please wait and try again later.

mobile.passwordWebOnly: This account uses a password. Please sign in on the web app instead.
